message: Fixes license Restore end-to-end. The client now identifies the installed customer only from the hardware-bound license file (never from the public revocation cache), preserves a DPAPI-protected local activation backup, clears stale revocation cache after a verified restore, verifies the signed revocation list itself, and automatically relaunches the same licensed hardware session when the publisher restores access while the client remains open. No new activation key is required after Restore.
